inlines.v: INN'KEEPER, noun [inn and keep.] An innholder. In America, the innkeeper is often a tavern keeper or taverner, as well as an innkeeper the inn for furnishing lodgings and provisions being usually united with the tavern for the sale of liquors. INN, verb intransitive To take up lodging; to lodge. INN, verb transitive To house; to put under cover.
